svg.text: BACK wall of the box: sensor and servo cables, through a cable gland
Sensor power: 5 V (from USB) or 3.3 V, with GND
FRONT: one BNC jack per output, on the lid (drawn in a row here; on the lid, two rows of five read D2 to D13)
Arduino Nano Screw Terminal Adapter (ASX00037), turned so its D2–D12 row faces the BNC panel
(its reset button and LEDs are here)
Sensors on inputs 0–7 (beam breaks, nose pokes, lick sensors): signal wires
stay on these screw terminals, not on BNCs
On a Nano ESP32 this row’s “REF” is boot pin B0 and its “RST” is boot pin B1: leave both empty, and VIN (USB powers the board).
